name: Yosep Anggi Noen
bio: Yosep Anggi Noen (born in Jogjakarta March 15, 1983)  is an Indonesian filmmaker and screenwriter.  Some of the awards he has achieved include the Citra Award for Best Director. Some of his films are screened at international film festivals, such as the International Film Festival Rotterdam (for the film "Hujan tak jadi datang/It's Not Raining Outside (2009, short)"), Locarno Film Festival (for "Vakansi yang Janggal dan Penyakit Lainnya/Peculiar Vacation and Other Illnesses (2012)"), Vancouver International Film Festival 2013 (managed to get a Special Mention Award for Vacancies), the Okinawa International Film Festival 2015 (for "Rumah/Home (2015, short)"), and the 2018 Toronto International Film Festival (for the short film Ballad of Blood and Two White Buckets)

credits.title: Jilah and the Man with Two Names
credits.overview: After exchanging hundreds of nude pictures, a woman’s virtual date suddenly disappears. After a period of time, she eventually meets him in person, but he is not the man she dated virtually. It turns out she had been catfished by a 21-year-old construction worker.

credits.title: Voice of Baceprot
credits.overview: A documentary on all-girl heavy metal band from a small village in Jawa Barat who formed the band in 2014 as Madrasah Tsanawiyah schoolgirls and recently completed their sold-out European tour.

credits.title: The Sea Speaks His Name
credits.overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia's New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

credits.title: Rangga & Cinta
credits.overview: After a popular girl loses a poetry contest to an outcast, they develop an unexpected interest in each other – but is their young love meant to be?

credits.title: The Redemption of Sin
credits.overview: When the police halt their search, a troubled mother works with a podcaster to find her missing daughter but faces a dark force that haunts her.

credits.title: 24 Hours with Gaspar
credits.overview: With only 24 hours left to live, a private investigator follows a trail of confounding clues to uncover the disappearance of his childhood friend.

credits.title: YK48
credits.overview: A documentary about the history of local film scene in Yogyakarta.

credits.title: The Science of Fictions
credits.overview: Siman discover a foreign crew shooting a moon landing. He gets caught and his tongue is cut off. He goes through life in slow motion, imitating an astronaut in outer space, labeled as crazy.

credits.title: Ballad of Blood and Two White Buckets
credits.overview: Ning and Mur, a couple who sells congealed blood for a living, face a huge ordeal when people stop consuming blood due to a shift in religious beliefs. But they are sick of all hypocrites.

credits.title: Solo, Solitude
credits.overview: The Suharto regime has been holding power in Indonesia for over 30 years, shutting down democracy time and time again. credits.title: Love Story Not
credits.overview: Love Story Not explores the daily lives of two female prositutes, Martha and Ning, focusing on the dynamics of the relationships with the people around them, particularly their relationship with Erik King, their shared lover.

credits.title: Rumah
credits.overview: Ayumi, 34 years old, has been working as an information call center operator for the past 10 years. credits.title: Genre Sub Genre
credits.overview: Genre Sub Genre is a short experimental episodic film that documents the predictions of a land in the Southeast of Indonesia.

credits.title: Reality, So?
credits.overview: A boring NGO documentary. The film descends into chaos when a television crew arrives and starts toying with the meaning of reality in a village.

credits.title: A Lady Caddy Who Never Saw a Hole in One
credits.overview: "A Lady Caddy Who Never Saw a Hole in One" displays a love story filled with absurdities regarding homeland, jealousy, hope, and fundamentally a statement about luck. Ning is a female caddy, while Mur is a man who is loyal to his homeland.

credits.title: Peculiar Vacation and Other Illnesses
credits.overview: Ning, a young Catholic woman, takes up a better job with a furniture company, while her hapless husband—occasionally hawking gasoline—spends most of his time doing pretty much nothing. credits.title: Say Hello to Yellow
credits.overview: A small yellow object makes a child trapped in an illusion and pretense. The device that should serve to bring a much closer instead turned into farther the closeness. A innocent portrait on a modernity that arrogant and stutter.

credits.title: Working Girls
credits.overview: A three-part documentary directed by five young Indonesian filmmakers. It tells the stories about girls that carry burdens as the backbone of their family.

credits.title: Walang Weling Wulang
credits.overview: Damar, Suluh, and Azizah are classmates. During religious studies, Suluh has difficulties memorizing a Qur'an verse. The class teacher assigns Azizah to teach him, however Azizah doesn't like Suluh because he likes to tease her classmates. She asks the assistance of Damar, a Christian boy, to help him.

credits.title: It's Not Raining Outside
credits.overview: A man and a woman bring a sofa into a room that is too small and don't know how or where to turn.

credits.title: Night Shift
credits.overview: Aziz and his cousin come to Jakarta to enroll in college. They work in a 24 hour mini-market where Aziz gets caught in a crime committed by Jamal, an old friend and his colleague at work.

credits.title: Cheng Cheng Po
credits.overview: Four children get together to help the poorest of them to find a way to keep coming to school and attend the exams.

credits.title: The Waiting
credits.overview: Everyone agrees that waiting is boring. Dull and exhausting. Suratinah is waiting for her boyfriend to accompany her to the city.

credits.title: Met Father
credits.overview: A mother tells her son the truth about his father: he is incarcerated in the city.
